item.text:
The coverage map below links every requirement to the proposed tickets. Ticket letters are provisional; Storybloq assigns IDs during setup.

| Source | Requirement | Planned coverage |
|---|---|---|
| Brief · Background | 40 plots, allocated per March–October season | **B:** plot inventory, configurable season dates, and allocation records |
| Brief · First version 1 | Apply for the coming season with up to three preferred plots | **E:** application form, preference validation, submission receipt |
| Brief · First version 2 | Coordinator reviews applications and allocates plots | **E:** application review list; **F:** allocation rules; **G:** coordinator controls |
| Brief · First version 2 | Move unallocated applicants to a waiting list in application order | **F:** queue and promotion logic; **G:** queue management |
| Brief · First version 3 | Gardener sees their allocated plot and season dates | **H:** own-allocation view, including pending and waitlisted states |
| Brief · First version 4 | Gardener reports a problem with their plot | **J:** authorized reporting, validation, and submission receipt |
| Brief · First version 4 | Coordinator sees open problems and marks them resolved | **J:** coordinator problem list and resolution workflow |
| Brief · First version 5 | Coordinator sees a grid of all 40 plots and their holders | **G:** allocation grid and accessible list alternative |
| Brief · Rules | At most one plot per household per season | **B:** database constraints; **C:** canonical household membership; **F:** transactional enforcement |
| Brief · Rules | Previous-season holders applying before 1 February receive allocation priority | **B:** prior-season history; **E:** submission timestamps; **F:** priority and cutoff tests |
| Brief · Rules | Waiting list is strictly first come, first served | **E:** stable original timestamps; **F:** FIFO ordering and promotion; **G:** visible queue order |
| Brief · Constraints | Works on phones | **A:** mobile prototype; **C/E/G/H/J:** mobile workflows; **L:** complete phone-journey verification |
| Brief · Constraints | Gardener contact details visible only to coordinator | **C:** authorization boundaries; **G/H/J/K:** restricted data exposure; **L:** privacy regression checks |
| Brief · Constraints | Large text, plain language, usable by people less confident with technology | **A:** prototype and usability review; all UI tickets: clear states and accessible controls; **L:** usability/accessibility verification |
| Your sign-in decision | Emailed one-time links, no passwords | **C:** single-use expiring links, resend/recovery, and session handling |
| Your notification decision | One daily coordinator email listing new problem reports | **K:** daily digest, durable delivery tracking, retries, and failure tests; **L:** staging delivery verification |
| Brief · Later | Online plot-fee payment | **Explicitly deferred** |
| Brief · Later | Shared tool-lending shelf | **Explicitly deferred** |

The plan also includes supporting work inferred from those requirements. These are labelled assumptions, not additional brief requirements:

| Supporting assumption or responsibility | Coverage |
|---|---|
| Coordinator verifies new household membership to prevent duplicate entitlements | **C**, reviewed through **D** |
| Each plot has at most one household holder per season | **B/F:** database and allocation constraints |
| Garden timezone, stable timestamp tie-breaking, and late-returner treatment | **B/E/F**, reviewed through **D** |
| Preferences do not guarantee a particular plot | **E/F/G:** clear application and allocation behaviour |
| Failed or concurrent allocation requests cannot double-allocate | **B/F:** transaction and concurrency tests |
| Daily email failures do not silently lose reports | **K:** durable digest tracking, recovery, and failure visibility |
| Deployment, backup restoration, and operator handoff | **L** |

Owner checkpoints provide three demonstrations: **D** reviews the early experience and implementation assumptions; **I** demonstrates allocation correctness; **N** accepts the complete first version.

This inspection changes no scope or dependencies. No files have been written.

Reviewer probe: `command -v codex` printed nothing
Independent review: approve, invocation R2

How should I proceed with this setup?
Approve setup
Adjust the plan
Inspect details

The story skill’s [setup workflow](/private/tmp/cc-cpm-w4-t536/onboarding-eval-6ewi2j/home/.agents/skills/story/setup-flow.md) requires “Nothing is written before approval,” so creating the reviewed package still needs your approval.
